info.name: TapWallet Full Project API
info.description: Authenticated Spring Boot REST API for the TapWallet Web Technology project. Run 0. Authentication / Admin login first; it stores {{accessToken}}, which the collection uses as a bearer token. The actor-scoped requests demonstrate customer and merchant data isolation. Remaining folders cover CRUD, validation, business rules, payments, and reversal. Seed data: users 1-5, wallets 1-2, merchants 1-2.

request.description: Authenticates the administrator and stores the default collection bearer token.
Creates a customer. Saves the new id into {{userId}}.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.id) pm.collectionVariables.set("userId", j.id);
